title: The Live Drop
author: Marguerite Galloway
blurb: Casper Dunmore, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
